test_cases.title: Valid credentials — redirects to dashboard
test_cases.precondition: A valid user account exists in the staging environment
steps: Enter a valid registered email address
test_cases.expected: User is redirected to the main dashboard within 2 seconds
test_cases.actual: User was redirected to the dashboard in approximately 1.2 seconds

test_cases.title: Invalid password — error message is displayed
test_cases.precondition: A valid user account exists in the staging environment
steps: Enter a valid registered email address
test_cases.expected: An inline error message 'Invalid email or password' appears below the form
test_cases.actual: Error message 'Invalid email or password' displayed correctly below the password field
test_cases.notes: Error message does not reveal whether the email exists (good for security)

test_cases.title: 'Remember me' — session persists after browser restart
test_cases.precondition: User is logged out; browser history and cookies cleared
test_cases.expected: User is still logged in and the dashboard loads without prompting for credentials
test_cases.actual: User is redirected to the login page — the session was not persisted across the browser restart
test_cases.notes: Reproduced on Chrome 124, Firefox 125. Safari not tested. The remember_token cookie is set but appears to not be read on restart.

bugs.title: 'Remember me' session does not persist after browser restart
bugs.description: The 'Remember me' checkbox is visible and clickable on the login form, but checking it has no effect. After a complete browser restart, the user is redirected to the login page as if the session expired.
steps: Log in to the app with 'Remember me' checked
Confirm you are on the dashboard
bugs.expected: Browser restores the authenticated session and loads the dashboard directly
bugs.actual: Login page is shown; the remember_token cookie is present but the server does not accept it
bugs.notes: The cookie is set with a 30-day expiry but the server-side token store may not be persisting it.
